headword: {調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}
reading: ちょうざいやっきょく

definitions.explanation: A pharmacy licensed to fill doctors' prescriptions and prepare prescription medicine, as opposed to a drugstore that mainly sells over-the-counter products and daily goods.

examples.japanese: {処方箋|しょほうせん}を{調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}に{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I hand in my prescription at the dispensing pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}くの{調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}で{薬|くすり}を{受|う}け{取|と}った。
examples.english: I picked up my medicine at a nearby dispensing pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}で{診察|しんさつ}を{受|う}けた{後|あと}、{調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}で{薬|くすり}をもらう。
examples.english: After being examined at the hospital, you get your medicine at a dispensing pharmacy.

notes:
A pharmacy licensed to prepare and dispense prescription drugs. Since the spread of {医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう} (separation of prescribing and dispensing), most prescriptions are filled at these rather than inside hospitals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}で{薬|くすり}をもらう: to get medicine at a dispensing pharmacy
- {調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく}に{勤|つと}める: to work at a dispensing pharmacy
- {門前|もんぜん}{薬局|やっきょく}: a pharmacy located just outside a hospital

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薬局|やっきょく}: pharmacy — general term; may or may not fill prescriptions
- ドラッグストア: drugstore — sells over-the-counter medicine, cosmetics, and daily goods
